name: vatranscribe
description: VATranscribe monorepo: FastAPI backend, Celery worker, React/Vite frontend.

scripts.clean: turbo run clean && rimraf node_modules .turbo apps/web/node_modules apps/web/dist
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build:marketing && npm run build:web
scripts.ci:frontend: npm install --include=optional --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build:marketing && npm run build:web
scripts.compose:prod:build: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.prod.yml build web
scripts.compose:prod:up: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d web
scripts.compose:prod:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f infra/compose/docker-compose.prod.yml logs web -f
